translations.english: Now racing across the blue horizon

translations.english: Feeling the sharpened flow of time

translations.romaji: Ah tokimeki e to ugokidasu sekai wa
translations.english: Ah, the world beginning to move toward excitement

translations.romaji: wasurekaketeta tooi yume no otozure
translations.english: The arrival of a distant dream I had almost forgotten

translations.romaji: Ride on time samayou omoi nara
translations.english: Ride on time, if these are wandering thoughts
